description: Ancient Jerusalem at sunrise from the Mount of Olives
alt: Ancient Jerusalem glowing gold at sunrise, seen from an olive grove with a traveller on the path.
interpretation_note: Artistic reconstruction of Second Temple-era Jerusalem; architecture is approximate, not an archaeological model.

description: Light breaking over the primordial waters
alt: Rays of light breaking over dark waters as land and plants emerge.
interpretation_note: Artistic interpretation. Faces, clothing, colours and composition are imagined; only the event itself is described in Scripture.
